dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with a smooth parabolic spline curvature from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a low-radius rounded vertex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-60 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Prominent convex arc with a medium-radius curvature fitting the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stout rostrum with a thick vertical profile relative to its horizontal extension.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle of approximately 145 degrees at the melon-rostrum junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single oval-shaped depigmented lesion or scar on the upper right flank, posterior to the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-teal coloration across the visible dermal surface.
